bootstrap_unit: Question. Retain all menus, rotations, rounds, arms, and policy outcomes under each resampled question.
descriptive_endpoints: accuracy by round and at full question
evidence_scope: Frozen-policy protocol-development transfer; original corpus was previously analyzed, so not pristine confirmatory evaluation.
fit_uncertainty: Condition on the previously frozen fitted policies; no refits in the bootstrap.
fitting: None. Copy the two exact plain calibrators, thresholds, and fixed rounds from frozen fitted_parameters.json.

go_no_go.added_stopping_value: Separately require the 98.75% lower bound versus the frozen fixed-round plain baseline to exceed zero before claiming stopping adds value over that simple baseline.
go_no_go.failure: Negative or uncertain transfer returns development to calibration/reward design. Preserve this evaluation; any revised policy requires a separately reserved evaluation set.
go_no_go.mixed_or_inconclusive: Report menu-specific uncertainty; do not refit, tune, replace the policy, or declare the 20-question pilot confirmed.
go_no_go.transfer_improvement: Per menu: 98.75% lower bound for plain frozen threshold minus native WAIT is greater than zero; 95% descriptive lower bound on absolute reward is greater than zero.

multiplicity: Bonferroni: four prespecified two-sided 98.75% percentile intervals. No claim beyond this finite selected-protocol transfer.
primary_endpoint: Mean episodic reward, equally averaged over four answer rotations within question.
prohibited: Changing prompt or threshold after seeing transfer outcomes
